title: Supplied tract ownership and exceptions for review

observations.statement: The supplied shallow operating transfer preserves separate record title and deep operating rights.

citations.quote: Fictional supplied opening schedule: Élodie 🛢 LLC holds 1/1 record title and 1/1 operating rights in tract.fictional from 0 ft to 18000 ft. This is an operator-attested starting claim, not an examined title opinion.

Fictional supplied transfer: Élodie 🛢 LLC conveys 1/2 of its operating rights to Cobalt Example LLC in tract.fictional from 0 ft to 9000 ft. Record title and operating rights from 9000 ft to 18000 ft are not conveyed.

observations.statement: Review the supplied starting claim and recording links; public-record coverage is unverified.

observations.statement: The supplied royalty and ORRI have different explicit share bases.
